brief: A right uppercut: the fist drops, then rises into the target's jaw (the head, from below) at 0.8 s, elbow bent at least 80 deg, feet planted.
notes: Fighter 2 is a still target facing the hero. 30 fps.

asserts.line: right fist touches fighter 2 head at 0.8 s +-2 f
right elbow above 80 deg bend at 0.8 s +-2 f
right fist at least 25 cm from fighter 2 head at 0.6 s +-2 f
